integrity: The proof constructs socle-supported vertices in each local factor and checks the perfect-matching parity obstruction exactly. Finite computations are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to nonreduced commutative Artinian rings with at least two local factors.
The ordinary and total domination lower bound is supplied by published zero-divisor-graph domination results; the new theorem determines paired domination.
No formula is asserted for local Artinian rings, non-Artinian rings, or noncommutative zero-divisor graphs.
title: Paired domination of zero-divisor graphs in the nonreduced Artinian regime
